name: B10-0166/2026 (S&D) – Human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and calling for action. It condemns the tricking of African men and women into working for Russia's war in Ukraine, through fake job offers on social media. It asks countries to stop these recruitment networks, punish those running them, warn their citizens, and hold social media platforms responsible. It also asks Russia to send recruited people home safely and to stop fighting in Ukraine.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and set of requests, not a new law.
- **Who it affects:** African recruits, their home countries, social media platforms, and Russia.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the European Commission, member states, the African Union, the United Nations and several governments.
